The comment does, however, clearly specify what needs to be addressed: adding other GNN architectures, such as those used in the standard experiments. This provides a clear direction for improvement even though the referenced part cannot be precisely located. Thus the comment specifies what needs to be addressed but fails to explicitly identify which part of the paper it targets.
